exposure: Ductal status (presence/type of patent ductus arteriosus - PDA)
outcome: Splanchnic oxygenation (SrSO2) response to enteral feeding
cohort: 50 preterm infants who were less than 32 weeks' gestation.
finding: The presence of PDA (restrictive or hemodynamically significant) did not significantly affect splanchnic oxygenation response to enteral feeding or increase gut complications.
